user.title: Add Appliance
user.description: Set up a new appliance to track by its power consumption.

data_description.appliance_name: A friendly name for this appliance (e.g., 'Kitchen Dishwasher').
data_description.appliance_type: The type of appliance. This sets smart default thresholds.
data_description.power_sensor: The power (W) sensor entity that monitors this appliance.

thresholds.title: Power Thresholds
thresholds.description: Configure power thresholds for **{appliance_name}**. The defaults are optimized for your appliance type — adjust only if needed.

data_description.start_threshold: Power (W) above which the appliance is considered to have started.
data_description.stop_threshold: Power (W) below which the appliance is considered to have stopped.
data_description.start_delay: How long (seconds) power must stay above the start threshold before transitioning to Running.
data_description.stop_delay: How long (seconds) power must stay below the stop threshold before transitioning to Finishing.
data_description.finishing_delay: How long (seconds) power must stay low to confirm the cycle is Complete (handles mid-cycle pauses).
data_description.complete_timeout: How long (seconds) to stay in Complete state before auto-resetting to Idle.

error.sensor_not_found: The selected power sensor was not found. Please check the entity ID.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already configured for tracking.
